title: ruta graveolens f. variegata
intro: Ruta graveolens f. variegata, commonly known as the variegated rue, is a plant species that is characterized by its variegated or multicolored leaves. The health benefits of Ruta graveolens f. variegata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a treatment for various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, as well as its potential to reduce anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Ruta graveolens f. variegata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
